\texttt{n\_\allowbreak{}estimators} is a ceiling of 5,000 with early stopping after 50 rounds.
\texttt{tune.\allowbreak{}py} searches outside \texttt{dvc repro}, recorded in MLflow only.

  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Adopt the point with the lowest validation L1: its gain lies inside the noise.
\item Optuna or seller-grouped cross-validation: about five times the fits, for a region found flat.
\item No correction across sweeps: k sweeps adopt a lucky point in up to k times 5\,\% of cases.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} No sweep's interval lies below zero.
